definition: Wojciech Zaremba (born 30 November 1988) is a Polish computer scientist and co-founder of OpenAI (2016–present).
details: Co-founded OpenAI, led the robotics team that solved the Rubik's Cube one-handed, and co-created OpenAI Codex (powering GitHub Copilot). He initially led OpenAI's work on robotics, notably creating a robotic arm capable of solving a Rubik's Cube. When the team was dissolved in 2020, he began leading teams working on OpenAI's GPT models, GitHub Copilot, and Codex.

explainer.lead: Wojciech Zaremba is a Polish-American computer scientist. His work spans machine learning.

timeline.what: In 2007, Zaremba represented Poland in the International Mathematical Olympiad in Vietnam, and won a silver medal.
He received a bachelor's degree in mathematics in 2010, followed by a bachelor's degree in computer science and a master's degree in mathematics in 2012, all from the University of Warsaw.
In 2015, Zaremba became one of the co-founders of OpenAI, an artificial intelligence research company.
Zaremba graduated and received his PhD in 2016.
